obfuscation_indicators: expects COVID-19 to continue to impact
risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed but uses complex segment and adjusted EBITDA definitions that may obscure underlying operating performance. Key risks include COVID-19 disruption, declining sales and margins, substantial goodwill write-downs, litigation and uncertain recovery of a Saudi Arabian letter of credit. Management expresses confidence in legal recovery but acknowledges significant jurisdictional, enforcement, timing, and collectability uncertainty.
